title: Roof coverings.
officialText:
Roof coverings shall comply with the requirements for roof decks pursuant to Section 1609.7.1.
Exceptions:
1. Rigid tile roof coverings that are air permeable and installed over a roof deck complying with Section 1609.7.1 are permitted to be designed in accordance with Section 1609.7.3.
2. Asphalt shingles installed over a roof deck complying with Section 1609.7.1 shall comply with the wind-resistance requirements of Section 1507.2.7.1.
